make.label: Make Struct
make.description: Builds a struct value of the chosen Struct Type from its fields.

break.label: Break Struct
break.description: Splits a struct value of the chosen Struct Type into its fields.

make.label: Make Array
make.description: Builds a new array from the given elements, in order.

length.label: Array Length
length.description: Returns how many elements are in the array.

get.label: Array Get
get.description: Returns the element at an index, and whether it existed.

set.label: Array Set
set.description: Replaces the element at an index, if the index is in bounds.

add.label: Array Add
add.description: Appends a value to the end of the array.

append.label: Array Append
append.description: Concatenates two arrays into one, keeping order and duplicates.

insert.label: Array Insert
insert.description: Inserts a value at an index, shifting later elements over.

removeAt.label: Array Remove At
removeAt.description: Removes the element at an index, if the index is in bounds.

removeItem.label: Array Remove Item
removeItem.description: Removes the first element that matches a given value.

clear.label: Array Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty array, discarding all elements.

contains.label: Array Contains
contains.description: True if the array contains this value anywhere.

findIndex.label: Array Find Index
findIndex.description: Returns the index of the first matching element, or -1.

isEmpty.label: Array Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the array has no elements.

reverse.label: Array Reverse
reverse.description: Returns a copy of the array with elements in reverse order.

forEach.label: Array For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each array element, in order.

basic.label: Basic Auth
basic.description: Builds an HTTP Basic Auth header value from a username and password.

oauth2ClientCredentials.label: OAuth2 Client Credentials
oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Requests an access token from an OAuth2 token endpoint using the client credentials grant (client ID and secret, no user involved).

oauth2Saml.label: OAuth2 SAML Bearer
oauth2Saml.description: Fetches a signed SAML assertion from an IdP endpoint, then exchanges it for an OAuth2 access token from a token endpoint, using a named Credential Vault entry.

authorize.label: Dropbox Authorize
authorize.description: One-time setup step: reads a named Credential Vault entry's App Key/App Secret/Authorization Code and exchanges the code for a long-lived refresh token to save back into the vault. Every other Dropbox node uses that refresh token (via its own Credential Name pin) automatically, refreshing its access token on demand.

upload.label: Dropbox Upload
upload.description: Uploads content to a path in Dropbox.

download.label: Dropbox Download
download.description: Downloads the content of a file at a path in Dropbox.

listFolders.label: Dropbox List Folders
listFolders.description: Lists the folders under a path in Dropbox, optionally including nested subfolders.

move.label: Dropbox Move
move.description: Moves a file or folder from one Dropbox path to another.

copy.label: Dropbox Copy
copy.description: Copies a file or folder from one Dropbox path to another.

rename.label: Dropbox Rename
rename.description: Renames a file or folder by moving it to a new path within Dropbox.

delete.label: Dropbox Delete
delete.description: Deletes a file or folder at a path in Dropbox.

createFolder.label: Dropbox Create Folder
createFolder.description: Creates a new folder at a path in Dropbox.

getMetadata.label: Dropbox Get Metadata
getMetadata.description: Fetches metadata (size, content hash, last modified) for a file or folder at a path in Dropbox, without downloading its content.

search.label: Dropbox Search
search.description: Searches file and folder names/content across Dropbox (or under a given path) for a query.

listRevisions.label: Dropbox List Revisions
listRevisions.description: Lists the historical revisions of a file at a path in Dropbox.

restore.label: Dropbox Restore
restore.description: Restores a file at a path in Dropbox to a previous revision.

permanentlyDelete.label: Dropbox Permanently Delete
permanentlyDelete.description: Permanently deletes a file or folder at a path in Dropbox, bypassing the trash.

getTemporaryLink.label: Dropbox Get Temporary Link
getTemporaryLink.description: Gets a temporary direct-download link for a file at a path in Dropbox.

getTemporaryUploadLink.label: Dropbox Get Temporary Upload Link
getTemporaryUploadLink.description: Gets a temporary link that can be used to upload directly to a path in Dropbox without proxying the bytes through this server.

moveBatch.label: Dropbox Move Batch
moveBatch.description: Moves multiple files or folders from one Dropbox path to another in a single batch.

copyBatch.label: Dropbox Copy Batch
copyBatch.description: Copies multiple files or folders from one Dropbox path to another in a single batch.

deleteBatch.label: Dropbox Delete Batch
deleteBatch.description: Deletes multiple files or folders at once in Dropbox.

createSharedLink.label: Dropbox Create Shared Link
createSharedLink.description: Creates a public shared link for a file or folder at a path in Dropbox.

listSharedLinks.label: Dropbox List Shared Links
listSharedLinks.description: Lists the shared links for a path (or the whole account, if empty) in Dropbox.

shareFolder.label: Dropbox Share Folder
shareFolder.description: Converts a folder at a path in Dropbox into a shared folder.

addFolderMember.label: Dropbox Add Folder Member
addFolderMember.description: Invites a member by email to an existing shared folder in Dropbox.

getCurrentAccount.label: Dropbox Get Current Account
getCurrentAccount.description: Fetches the account ID, name and email of the Dropbox account an access token belongs to.

getSpaceUsage.label: Dropbox Get Space Usage
getSpaceUsage.description: Fetches the used and allocated storage space (bytes) for a Dropbox account.

postMessage.label: Slack Post Message
postMessage.description: Posts a text message to a Slack channel (or as a threaded reply if a Thread Timestamp is given).

updateMessage.label: Slack Update Message
updateMessage.description: Edits the text of an existing message.

postEphemeral.label: Slack Post Ephemeral Message
postEphemeral.description: Posts a message visible only to a single user in a channel.

scheduleMessage.label: Slack Schedule Message
scheduleMessage.description: Schedules a message to be posted at a future Unix timestamp (in seconds).

listConversations.label: Slack List Conversations
listConversations.description: Lists channels the bot can see in the workspace.

createConversation.label: Slack Create Conversation
createConversation.description: Creates a new public or private channel.

inviteToConversation.label: Slack Invite To Conversation
inviteToConversation.description: Invites one or more users to a channel.

kickFromConversation.label: Slack Kick From Conversation
kickFromConversation.description: Removes a user from a channel.

joinConversation.label: Slack Join Conversation
joinConversation.description: Joins the bot to an existing channel.

getConversationHistory.label: Slack Get Conversation History
getConversationHistory.description: Fetches recent messages from a channel.

getConversationMembers.label: Slack Get Conversation Members
getConversationMembers.description: Lists the user IDs that are members of a channel.

getUserInfo.label: Slack Get User Info
getUserInfo.description: Fetches profile information for a single user.

lookupUserByEmail.label: Slack Lookup User By Email
lookupUserByEmail.description: Finds a user by their email address.

uploadFile.label: Slack Upload File
uploadFile.description: Uploads a file to Slack and shares it to a channel.

getFileInfo.label: Slack Get File Info
getFileInfo.description: Fetches metadata about an uploaded file.

addReaction.label: Slack Add Reaction
addReaction.description: Adds an emoji reaction to an existing message.

removeReaction.label: Slack Remove Reaction
removeReaction.description: Removes an emoji reaction from an existing message.

addPin.label: Slack Add Pin
addPin.description: Pins a message to a channel.

removePin.label: Slack Remove Pin
removePin.description: Unpins a message from a channel.

listPins.label: Slack List Pins
listPins.description: Lists pinned items in a channel.

searchMessages.label: Slack Search Messages
searchMessages.description: Searches messages across the workspace (requires a user token; bot tokens are not supported by this Slack endpoint).

updateUserGroup.label: Slack Update User Group
updateUserGroup.description: Updates a user group's name and/or handle.

updateUserGroupUsers.label: Slack Update User Group Users
updateUserGroupUsers.description: Replaces the full member list of a user group.

addReminder.label: Slack Add Reminder
addReminder.description: Creates a reminder from text and a time (Unix seconds, or a natural language description).

getCustomer.label: Stripe Get Customer
getCustomer.description: Retrieves an existing Stripe customer by ID.

deleteCustomer.label: Stripe Delete Customer
deleteCustomer.description: Permanently deletes a Stripe customer by ID.

listCustomers.label: Stripe List Customers
listCustomers.description: Lists customers, optionally filtered by email.

createPaymentIntent.label: Stripe Create Payment Intent
createPaymentIntent.description: Creates a payment intent for a given amount (in the smallest currency unit, e.g. cents) and currency, optionally attached to a customer.

getPaymentIntent.label: Stripe Get Payment Intent
getPaymentIntent.description: Retrieves a payment intent by ID.

cancelPaymentIntent.label: Stripe Cancel Payment Intent
cancelPaymentIntent.description: Cancels a payment intent that has not yet been captured.

createRefund.label: Stripe Create Refund
createRefund.description: Refunds a payment intent, fully if Amount is 0 or partially otherwise.

listCharges.label: Stripe List Charges
listCharges.description: Lists charges, optionally filtered to a single customer.

query.label: Salesforce Query
query.description: Runs a SOQL query and returns the matching records as a JSON array.

createRecord.label: Salesforce Create Record
createRecord.description: Creates a new record of the given sObject type from a JSON object of field values.

getRecord.label: Salesforce Get Record
getRecord.description: Retrieves a record by ID, optionally limited to a comma-separated list of fields.

updateRecord.label: Salesforce Update Record
updateRecord.description: Updates an existing record's fields from a JSON object of field values.

upsertRecord.label: Salesforce Upsert Record
upsertRecord.description: Creates or updates a record identified by an external ID field/value instead of the Salesforce record ID.

describeSobject.label: Salesforce Describe sObject
describeSobject.description: Retrieves the field metadata (name, label, type) for the given sObject type.

getWorkers.label: Workday Get Workers
getWorkers.description: Retrieves a page of worker records, optionally filtered by a search term.

getWorker.label: Workday Get Worker
getWorker.description: Retrieves a single worker record by Worker ID.

searchWorkers.label: Workday Search Workers
searchWorkers.description: Searches worker records matching a query string and returns the matching workers as a JSON array.

getStaffingOrganizations.label: Workday Get Staffing Organizations
getStaffingOrganizations.description: Retrieves a page of staffing organization records.

getOrganization.label: Workday Get Organization
getOrganization.description: Retrieves a single organization record by Organization ID.

sendSms.label: Twilio Send SMS
sendSms.description: Sends an SMS text message to a phone number.

getMessage.label: Twilio Get Message
getMessage.description: Retrieves a message record by Message SID.

listMessages.label: Twilio List Messages
listMessages.description: Lists messages, optionally filtered by To and/or From phone numbers.

deleteMessage.label: Twilio Delete Message
deleteMessage.description: Deletes a message record by Message SID.

makeCall.label: Twilio Make Call
makeCall.description: Places an outbound voice call, fetching call instructions from the given TwiML URL.

getCall.label: Twilio Get Call
getCall.description: Retrieves a call record by Call SID.

sendWhatsApp.label: Twilio Send WhatsApp Message
sendWhatsApp.description: Sends a WhatsApp message to a phone number via Twilio's WhatsApp channel.

listCalls.label: Twilio List Calls
listCalls.description: Lists calls, optionally filtered by To and/or From phone numbers.

hangupCall.label: Twilio Hang Up Call
hangupCall.description: Ends an in-progress call by Call SID.

lookupPhoneNumber.label: Twilio Lookup Phone Number
lookupPhoneNumber.description: Looks up formatting, validity, caller name, and line type info for a phone number via the Twilio Lookup API.

sendEmail.label: SendGrid Send Email
sendEmail.description: Sends an email via SendGrid's Mail Send API.

sendTemplateEmail.label: SendGrid Send Template Email
sendTemplateEmail.description: Sends an email using a SendGrid dynamic template.

sendMultiple.label: SendGrid Send Multiple
sendMultiple.description: Sends the same email individually to multiple recipients (each gets their own personalization, not a shared To list).

createApiKey.label: SendGrid Create API Key
createApiKey.description: Creates a new SendGrid API key, optionally restricted to a set of scopes.

listApiKeys.label: SendGrid List API Keys
listApiKeys.description: Lists the API keys on the account.

deleteApiKey.label: SendGrid Delete API Key
deleteApiKey.description: Deletes an API key by ID.

upsertContacts.label: SendGrid Upsert Contacts
upsertContacts.description: Creates or updates one or more Marketing Contacts, optionally adding them to lists.

getContactByEmail.label: SendGrid Get Contact By Email
getContactByEmail.description: Searches Marketing Contacts for one matching the given email address.

deleteContacts.label: SendGrid Delete Contacts
deleteContacts.description: Deletes Marketing Contacts by ID, or all contacts on the account.

createList.label: SendGrid Create List
createList.description: Creates a new Marketing Contacts list.

listContactLists.label: SendGrid List Contact Lists
listContactLists.description: Lists the Marketing Contacts lists on the account.

deleteList.label: SendGrid Delete List
deleteList.description: Deletes a Marketing Contacts list by ID.

getBounces.label: SendGrid Get Bounces
getBounces.description: Lists bounce suppression events, optionally filtered by a start/end time range.

deleteBounce.label: SendGrid Delete Bounce
deleteBounce.description: Removes a bounce suppression entry for an email address, or clears all bounces.

getEmailStats.label: SendGrid Get Email Stats
getEmailStats.description: Fetches daily global email statistics for a date range.

getVerifiedSenders.label: SendGrid Get Verified Senders
getVerifiedSenders.description: Lists the account's verified sender identities.

sendMail.label: SMTP Send Mail
sendMail.description: Sends an email over SMTP using the given credential.

verifyConnection.label: SMTP Verify Connection
verifyConnection.description: Tests that the given SMTP credential can authenticate with the server.

apiCall.label: SmartRecruiters API Call
apiCall.description: Calls any documented SmartRecruiters REST endpoint directly (escape hatch for endpoints without a dedicated node yet).

getEntitySet.label: SAP Get Entity Set
getEntitySet.description: Fetches an OData entity set (collection) from a SAP OData/Gateway service, e.g. /sap/opu/odata/sap/API_BUSINESS_PARTNER's A_BusinessPartner.

getEntity.label: SAP Get Entity
getEntity.description: Fetches a single OData entity from a SAP OData/Gateway service by its key predicate.

createEntity.label: SAP Create Entity
createEntity.description: Creates an OData entity in a SAP OData/Gateway service, handling the CSRF token handshake SAP requires for write operations.

updateEntity.label: SAP Update Entity
updateEntity.description: Updates (MERGE) an OData entity in a SAP OData/Gateway service by its key predicate, handling the CSRF token handshake SAP requires for write operations.

deleteEntity.label: SAP Delete Entity
deleteEntity.description: Deletes an OData entity from a SAP OData/Gateway service by its key predicate, handling the CSRF token handshake SAP requires for write operations.

generateAuthorizationUrl.label: LinkedIn Generate Authorization URL
generateAuthorizationUrl.description: Builds the member authorization URL to send a user to LinkedIn's OAuth consent page for the given scopes.

authorize.label: LinkedIn Authorize
authorize.description: One-time setup step: reads a named Credential Vault entry's Client ID/Client Secret/Redirect URI/Authorization Code and exchanges the code for a 3-legged access token (and refresh token, if enabled) to save back into the vault. Every other LinkedIn node uses that access token (via its own Credential Name pin) automatically.

refreshToken.label: LinkedIn Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Exchanges a named Credential Vault entry's stored Refresh Token for a new access token (and refresh token), without requiring the member to reauthorize.

getTwoLeggedAccessToken.label: LinkedIn Get Two-Legged Access Token
getTwoLeggedAccessToken.description: Uses the client credentials grant to retrieve a 2-legged access token for member-independent APIs. Requires the app to have client credential flow enabled.

introspectAccessToken.label: LinkedIn Introspect Access Token
introspectAccessToken.description: Inspects a 2-legged, 3-legged, or Enterprise access token to get its status, expiry, and other details. Inspects the given token, or the credential's own stored Access Token if left blank.

get.label: LinkedIn Get
get.description: Makes a Rest.li GET request to fetch a single entity from a LinkedIn API resource.

batchGet.label: LinkedIn Batch Get
batchGet.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_GET request to fetch multiple entities from a LinkedIn API resource in one call.

getAll.label: LinkedIn Get All
getAll.description: Makes a Rest.li GET_ALL request to fetch every entity on a LinkedIn API resource.

finder.label: LinkedIn Finder
finder.description: Makes a Rest.li FINDER request to find entities on a LinkedIn API resource matching some search criteria.

batchFinder.label: LinkedIn Batch Finder
batchFinder.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_FINDER request to find entities using multiple sets of search criteria in one call.

create.label: LinkedIn Create
create.description: Makes a Rest.li CREATE request to create a new entity on a LinkedIn API resource.

batchCreate.label: LinkedIn Batch Create
batchCreate.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_CREATE request to create multiple entities on a LinkedIn API resource in one call.

update.label: LinkedIn Update
update.description: Makes a Rest.li UPDATE request to overwrite an entire entity on a LinkedIn API resource.

batchUpdate.label: LinkedIn Batch Update
batchUpdate.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_UPDATE request to overwrite multiple entities on a LinkedIn API resource in one call.

partialUpdate.label: LinkedIn Partial Update
partialUpdate.description: Makes a Rest.li PARTIAL_UPDATE request to update only the given fields of an entity on a LinkedIn API resource.

batchPartialUpdate.label: LinkedIn Batch Partial Update
batchPartialUpdate.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_PARTIAL_UPDATE request to partially update multiple entities on a LinkedIn API resource in one call.

delete.label: LinkedIn Delete
delete.description: Makes a Rest.li DELETE request to delete an entity on a LinkedIn API resource.

batchDelete.label: LinkedIn Batch Delete
batchDelete.description: Makes a Rest.li BATCH_DELETE request to delete multiple entities on a LinkedIn API resource in one call.

action.label: LinkedIn Action
action.description: Makes a Rest.li ACTION request to perform a custom action on a LinkedIn API resource.

authorize.label: Facebook Authorize
authorize.description: One-time setup step: reads a named Credential Vault entry's App ID/App Secret/Redirect URI/Authorization Code and exchanges the code for a long-lived (~60 day) access token to save back into the vault. Every other Facebook node uses that access token (via its own Credential Name pin) automatically.

debugToken.label: Facebook Debug Token
debugToken.description: Inspects an access token — which app it belongs to, whether it's still valid, when it expires, and which permissions were granted.

getPageInfo.label: Facebook Get Page Info
getPageInfo.description: Fetches a Facebook Page's id, name, category, fan count and link.

createPost.label: Facebook Create Post
createPost.description: Publishes a text (and optional link) post to a Facebook Page's feed.

createPhotoPost.label: Facebook Create Photo Post
createPhotoPost.description: Publishes a photo (by URL) to a Facebook Page, with an optional caption.

createVideoPost.label: Facebook Create Video Post
createVideoPost.description: Publishes a video (by URL) to a Facebook Page, with an optional description.

getPosts.label: Facebook Get Posts
getPosts.description: Lists the most recent posts on a Facebook Page's feed.

getPageInsights.label: Facebook Get Page Insights
getPageInsights.description: Fetches Page-level insight metrics (e.g. page_impressions, page_fans) for a given period, as raw JSON.

createComment.label: Facebook Create Comment
createComment.description: Posts a comment on a post or another comment.

getComments.label: Facebook Get Comments
getComments.description: Lists the comments on a post or other object.

likeObject.label: Facebook Like
likeObject.description: Likes a post, comment, or other likeable object, on behalf of the access token's identity.

unlikeObject.label: Facebook Unlike
unlikeObject.description: Removes a like from a post, comment, or other likeable object.

getLikesCount.label: Facebook Get Likes Count
getLikesCount.description: Fetches the total like count for a post, comment, or other object.

getUserProfile.label: Facebook Get User Profile
getUserProfile.description: Fetches a user's id, name and email — leave User ID empty to use "me" (the access token's own identity).

getAdAccounts.label: Facebook Get Ad Accounts
getAdAccounts.description: Lists the ad accounts a user (or "me") has access to.

createCampaign.label: Facebook Create Campaign
createCampaign.description: Creates a new ad campaign under an ad account.

getCampaigns.label: Facebook Get Campaigns
getCampaigns.description: Lists the ad campaigns under an ad account.

deleteCampaign.label: Facebook Delete Campaign
deleteCampaign.description: Deletes an ad campaign by id.

getInsights.label: Facebook Get Insights
getInsights.description: Fetches ad-level insight metrics (impressions, spend, clicks, ...) for a campaign, ad set, or ad, as raw JSON.

apiCall.label: Facebook API Call
apiCall.description: Generic escape hatch: calls any Graph API path/edge this manager doesn't have a dedicated node for, authenticated with the vault credential's access token. Params is a JSON object string.

listContainers.label: Azure Storage List Containers
listContainers.description: Lists the containers in an Azure Storage account, optionally filtered by name prefix.

createContainer.label: Azure Storage Create Container
createContainer.description: Creates a container in an Azure Storage account if it doesn't already exist.

deleteContainer.label: Azure Storage Delete Container
deleteContainer.description: Deletes a container from an Azure Storage account if it exists.

getContainerProperties.label: Azure Storage Get Container Properties
getContainerProperties.description: Fetches metadata and properties (ETag, last modified, public access level) for a container.

setContainerMetadata.label: Azure Storage Set Container Metadata
setContainerMetadata.description: Replaces the custom metadata key/value pairs on a container.

listBlobs.label: Azure Storage List Blobs
listBlobs.description: Lists the blobs in a container, optionally filtered by prefix and recursing into virtual folders.

uploadBlob.label: Azure Storage Upload Blob
uploadBlob.description: Uploads content to a blob in a container, using the given upload options.

downloadBlob.label: Azure Storage Download Blob
downloadBlob.description: Downloads the content of a blob in a container.

deleteBlob.label: Azure Storage Delete Blob
deleteBlob.description: Deletes a blob from a container if it exists.

copyBlob.label: Azure Storage Copy Blob
copyBlob.description: Copies a blob from one container/path to another, server-side.

moveBlob.label: Azure Storage Move Blob
moveBlob.description: Moves a blob from one container/path to another by copying it then deleting the original.

getBlobProperties.label: Azure Storage Get Blob Properties
getBlobProperties.description: Fetches metadata and properties (size, content type, ETag, last modified) for a blob, without downloading its content.

setBlobMetadata.label: Azure Storage Set Blob Metadata
setBlobMetadata.description: Replaces the custom metadata key/value pairs on a blob.

blobExists.label: Azure Storage Blob Exists
blobExists.description: Checks whether a blob exists in a container.

generateBlobSasUrl.label: Azure Storage Generate Blob SAS URL
generateBlobSasUrl.description: Generates a time-limited Shared Access Signature URL granting direct access to a blob, e.g. permissions "r" (read) or "racwd" (read/add/create/write/delete).

generateContainerSasUrl.label: Azure Storage Generate Container SAS URL
generateContainerSasUrl.description: Generates a time-limited Shared Access Signature URL granting direct access to a container.

getAccountInfo.label: Azure Storage Get Account Info
getAccountInfo.description: Fetches the account kind and SKU name of an Azure Storage account.

listTables.label: Aws DynamoDB List Tables
listTables.description: Lists the table names in the account/region, optionally paginated.

createTable.label: Aws DynamoDB Create Table
createTable.description: Creates a new table with the given partition key and optional sort key.

describeTable.label: Aws DynamoDB Describe Table
describeTable.description: Fetches status, key schema, item count/size, and throughput settings for a table.

updateTableCapacity.label: Aws DynamoDB Update Table Capacity
updateTableCapacity.description: Changes a table's billing mode and/or provisioned read/write capacity units.

putItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Put Item
putItem.description: Creates or replaces an item in a table, optionally only if a condition expression holds.

getItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Get Item
getItem.description: Fetches a single item by its primary key.

updateItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Update Item
updateItem.description: Updates one or more attributes of an existing item (or creates it), using an update expression.

deleteItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Delete Item
deleteItem.description: Deletes a single item by its primary key, optionally only if a condition expression holds.

query.label: Aws DynamoDB Query
query.description: Queries items sharing a partition key (and optional sort key condition), optionally against a secondary index.

scan.label: Aws DynamoDB Scan
scan.description: Scans every item in a table or index, optionally filtered by a filter expression.

batchGetItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Batch Get Item
batchGetItem.description: Fetches up to 100 items from one table by their primary keys in a single request.

batchWriteItem.label: Aws DynamoDB Batch Write Item
batchWriteItem.description: Puts and/or deletes up to 25 items in one table in a single request.

transactGetItems.label: Aws DynamoDB Transact Get Items
transactGetItems.description: Atomically fetches up to 100 items across one or more tables, e.g. [{"tableName":"T","key":{"id":"1"}}].

transactWriteItems.label: Aws DynamoDB Transact Write Items
transactWriteItems.description: Atomically applies up to 100 put/update/delete/conditionCheck operations across one or more tables, e.g. [{"operation":"put","tableName":"T","item":{...}}].

listDatabases.label: MongoDB List Databases
listDatabases.description: Lists the database names visible to this connection.

listCollections.label: MongoDB List Collections
listCollections.description: Lists the collection names in a database.

createCollection.label: MongoDB Create Collection
createCollection.description: Creates a new (empty) collection in a database.

dropCollection.label: MongoDB Drop Collection
dropCollection.description: Drops a collection and all its documents/indexes.

dropDatabase.label: MongoDB Drop Database
dropDatabase.description: Drops an entire database and all its collections.

renameCollection.label: MongoDB Rename Collection
renameCollection.description: Renames a collection within the same database.

insertOne.label: MongoDB Insert One
insertOne.description: Inserts a single document into a collection.

insertMany.label: MongoDB Insert Many
insertMany.description: Inserts multiple documents into a collection in one request.

findOne.label: MongoDB Find One
findOne.description: Fetches the first document matching a filter.

find.label: MongoDB Find
find.description: Fetches documents matching a filter, optionally sorted/paginated.

updateOne.label: MongoDB Update One
updateOne.description: Applies an update operator document to the first document matching a filter, optionally upserting.

updateMany.label: MongoDB Update Many
updateMany.description: Applies an update operator document to every document matching a filter, optionally upserting.

replaceOne.label: MongoDB Replace One
replaceOne.description: Replaces the first document matching a filter with a new document, optionally upserting.

deleteOne.label: MongoDB Delete One
deleteOne.description: Deletes the first document matching a filter.

deleteMany.label: MongoDB Delete Many
deleteMany.description: Deletes every document matching a filter.

findOneAndUpdate.label: MongoDB Find One And Update
findOneAndUpdate.description: Atomically updates the first document matching a filter and returns its before/after state.

findOneAndReplace.label: MongoDB Find One And Replace
findOneAndReplace.description: Atomically replaces the first document matching a filter and returns its before/after state.

findOneAndDelete.label: MongoDB Find One And Delete
findOneAndDelete.description: Atomically deletes the first document matching a filter and returns the deleted document.

aggregate.label: MongoDB Aggregate
aggregate.description: Runs an aggregation pipeline against a collection, e.g. [{"$match":{...}},{"$group":{...}}].

distinct.label: MongoDB Distinct
distinct.description: Fetches the distinct values of a field across documents matching a filter.

createIndex.label: MongoDB Create Index
createIndex.description: Creates an index on one or more fields, e.g. {"email":1}.

listIndexes.label: MongoDB List Indexes
listIndexes.description: Lists the indexes defined on a collection.

bulkWrite.label: MongoDB Bulk Write
bulkWrite.description: Applies a mix of insertOne/updateOne/updateMany/replaceOne/deleteOne/deleteMany operations in a single request, e.g. [{"insertOne":{"document":{...}}}].

createStream.label: AWS Kinesis Create Stream
createStream.description: Creates a new data stream in the given capacity mode.

listStreams.label: AWS Kinesis List Streams
listStreams.description: Lists the stream names in the account/region, optionally paginated.

describeStreamSummary.label: AWS Kinesis Describe Stream Summary
describeStreamSummary.description: Fetches status, capacity mode, retention, shard count and encryption settings for a stream.

describeLimits.label: AWS Kinesis Describe Limits
describeLimits.description: Fetches the account/region's shard limit and current open shard count.

increaseStreamRetentionPeriod.label: AWS Kinesis Increase Stream Retention Period
increaseStreamRetentionPeriod.description: Increases a stream's retention period, in hours.

decreaseStreamRetentionPeriod.label: AWS Kinesis Decrease Stream Retention Period
decreaseStreamRetentionPeriod.description: Decreases a stream's retention period, in hours.

updateShardCount.label: AWS Kinesis Update Shard Count
updateShardCount.description: Scales a provisioned stream up or down to a target shard count.

listShards.label: AWS Kinesis List Shards
listShards.description: Lists the shards of a stream, optionally paginated.

mergeShards.label: AWS Kinesis Merge Shards
mergeShards.description: Merges two adjacent shards into a single shard.

splitShard.label: AWS Kinesis Split Shard
splitShard.description: Splits a shard into two new shards using a new starting hash key.

putRecord.label: AWS Kinesis Put Record
putRecord.description: Writes a single data record into a stream.

putRecords.label: AWS Kinesis Put Records
putRecords.description: Writes up to 500 data records into a stream in a single request, e.g. [{"data":"...","partitionKey":"..."}].

getShardIterator.label: AWS Kinesis Get Shard Iterator
getShardIterator.description: Gets a shard iterator, used to read records sequentially from a shard.

getRecords.label: AWS Kinesis Get Records
getRecords.description: Fetches data records from a shard using a shard iterator.

addTagsToStream.label: AWS Kinesis Add Tags To Stream
addTagsToStream.description: Adds or updates up to 50 tags on a stream.

removeTagsFromStream.label: AWS Kinesis Remove Tags From Stream
removeTagsFromStream.description: Removes tags with the given keys from a stream.

listTagsForStream.label: AWS Kinesis List Tags For Stream
listTagsForStream.description: Lists the tags attached to a stream, optionally paginated.

startStreamEncryption.label: AWS Kinesis Start Stream Encryption
startStreamEncryption.description: Enables server-side encryption on a stream using a customer-managed KMS key.

stopStreamEncryption.label: AWS Kinesis Stop Stream Encryption
stopStreamEncryption.description: Disables server-side encryption on a stream.

listIssues.label: GitHub List Issues
listIssues.description: Lists issues in a GitHub repository, optionally filtered by state.

createIssue.label: GitHub Create Issue
createIssue.description: Creates a new issue in a GitHub repository.

commentOnIssue.label: GitHub Comment On Issue
commentOnIssue.description: Adds a comment to an existing issue in a GitHub repository.

listPullRequests.label: GitHub List Pull Requests
listPullRequests.description: Lists pull requests in a GitHub repository, optionally filtered by state.

createPullRequest.label: GitHub Create Pull Request
createPullRequest.description: Opens a new pull request in a GitHub repository from one branch into another.

mergePullRequest.label: GitHub Merge Pull Request
mergePullRequest.description: Merges an open pull request in a GitHub repository using the chosen merge method.

getFileContent.label: GitHub Get File Content
getFileContent.description: Fetches the decoded text content of a file at a path in a GitHub repository, optionally at a specific branch/tag/commit.

createOrUpdateFile.label: GitHub Create Or Update File
createOrUpdateFile.description: Creates or updates a file at a path in a GitHub repository. Pass the SHA from GitHub Get File Content to update an existing file, or leave it blank to create a new one.

request.label: GitHub Request
request.description: Sends a raw request to any GitHub REST API route not covered by the other GitHub nodes, e.g. "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}".

createIssue.label: Jira Create Issue
createIssue.description: Creates a new issue in a Jira project (Cloud or Server/Data Center).

getIssue.label: Jira Get Issue
getIssue.description: Fetches an issue's summary, status and issue type by key.

updateIssue.label: Jira Update Issue
updateIssue.description: Updates an issue's summary and/or description. Leave a field blank to leave it unchanged.

searchIssues.label: Jira Search Issues
searchIssues.description: Searches issues using a JQL query.

addComment.label: Jira Add Comment
addComment.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

listTransitions.label: Jira List Transitions
listTransitions.description: Lists the workflow transitions currently available for an issue.

transitionIssue.label: Jira Transition Issue
transitionIssue.description: Moves an issue through its workflow using a transition ID from Jira List Transitions.

assignIssue.label: Jira Assign Issue
assignIssue.description: Assigns an issue to a user. Use an account ID for Jira Cloud, or a username for Jira Server/Data Center.

listProjects.label: Jira List Projects
listProjects.description: Lists all projects visible to the credential.

getProject.label: Jira Get Project
getProject.description: Fetches a project's details by key or ID.

addWorklog.label: Jira Add Worklog
addWorklog.description: Logs work against an issue, e.g. "1h 30m".

linkIssues.label: Jira Link Issues
linkIssues.description: Creates a link between two issues, e.g. "Relates", "Blocks", "Duplicate".

getUser.label: Jira Get User
getUser.description: Fetches a user's profile. Use Account ID for Jira Cloud, or Username for Jira Server/Data Center.

findUsers.label: Jira Find Users
findUsers.description: Searches for users matching a query (name or email).

listUsers.label: Microsoft 365 List Users
listUsers.description: Lists users in the Azure AD tenant, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

getUser.label: Microsoft 365 Get User
getUser.description: Fetches a single user's profile by ID or user principal name (UPN).

createUser.label: Microsoft 365 Create User
createUser.description: Creates a new user in the Azure AD tenant.

updateUser.label: Microsoft 365 Update User
updateUser.description: Updates a user's properties by ID or UPN using a raw JSON object of the fields to change.

deleteUser.label: Microsoft 365 Delete User
deleteUser.description: Deletes a user from the Azure AD tenant by ID or UPN.

listGroups.label: Microsoft 365 List Groups
listGroups.description: Lists groups in the Azure AD tenant, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

createGroup.label: Microsoft 365 Create Group
createGroup.description: Creates a new security or Microsoft 365 group in the Azure AD tenant.

deleteGroup.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Group
deleteGroup.description: Deletes a group from the Azure AD tenant by ID.

addGroupMember.label: Microsoft 365 Add Group Member
addGroupMember.description: Adds a user as a member of a group by ID.

sendMail.label: Microsoft 365 Send Mail
sendMail.description: Sends an email as a user via Outlook/Exchange Online.

listMessages.label: Microsoft 365 List Messages
listMessages.description: Lists messages in a user's mailbox, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

getMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Get Message
getMessage.description: Fetches a single email message's subject, sender and body content by ID.

deleteMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Message
deleteMessage.description: Deletes an email message from a user's mailbox by ID.

listEvents.label: Microsoft 365 List Events
listEvents.description: Lists events on a user's calendar.

createEvent.label: Microsoft 365 Create Event
createEvent.description: Creates a new event on a user's calendar.

deleteEvent.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Event
deleteEvent.description: Deletes an event from a user's calendar by ID.

listDriveItems.label: Microsoft 365 List Drive Items
listDriveItems.description: Lists the files and folders under a path in a user's OneDrive, or the root if left blank.

downloadFile.label: Microsoft 365 Download File
downloadFile.description: Downloads the content of a file at a path in a user's OneDrive.

uploadFile.label: Microsoft 365 Upload File
uploadFile.description: Uploads content to a path in a user's OneDrive, creating or overwriting the file.

deleteDriveItem.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Drive Item
deleteDriveItem.description: Deletes a file or folder at a path in a user's OneDrive.

listJoinedTeams.label: Microsoft 365 List Joined Teams
listJoinedTeams.description: Lists the Microsoft Teams teams a user is a member of.

sendChannelMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Send Channel Message
sendChannelMessage.description: Posts a message to a channel in a Microsoft Teams team.

listChannels.label: Microsoft 365 List Channels
listChannels.description: Lists the channels in a Microsoft Teams team.

createChannel.label: Microsoft 365 Create Channel
createChannel.description: Creates a new channel in a Microsoft Teams team.

listChannelMessages.label: Microsoft 365 List Channel Messages
listChannelMessages.description: Lists recent messages posted in a Microsoft Teams channel.

listChats.label: Microsoft 365 List Chats
listChats.description: Lists the 1:1 and group chats a user is a participant in.

sendChatMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Send Chat Message
sendChatMessage.description: Posts a message to a Microsoft Teams 1:1 or group chat.

listSites.label: Microsoft 365 List Sites
listSites.description: Searches for SharePoint sites in the tenant, or lists all sites if left blank.

listSiteLists.label: Microsoft 365 List Site Lists
listSiteLists.description: Lists the SharePoint lists in a site.

listListItems.label: Microsoft 365 List List Items
listListItems.description: Lists the items in a SharePoint list, with each item's fields as a JSON string.

createListItem.label: Microsoft 365 Create List Item
createListItem.description: Creates a new item in a SharePoint list from a JSON object of field values.

createFolder.label: Microsoft 365 Create Folder
createFolder.description: Creates a new folder at a path in a user's OneDrive.

moveDriveItem.label: Microsoft 365 Move Drive Item
moveDriveItem.description: Moves a file or folder in a user's OneDrive to a different folder.

copyDriveItem.label: Microsoft 365 Copy Drive Item
copyDriveItem.description: Copies a file or folder in a user's OneDrive to a different folder.

createSharingLink.label: Microsoft 365 Create Sharing Link
createSharingLink.description: Creates a sharing link for a file or folder in a user's OneDrive.

searchDriveItems.label: Microsoft 365 Search Drive Items
searchDriveItems.description: Searches a user's OneDrive for files and folders matching a query.

listWorksheets.label: Microsoft 365 List Worksheets
listWorksheets.description: Lists the worksheets in an Excel workbook stored in a user's OneDrive.

getWorksheetRange.label: Microsoft 365 Get Worksheet Range
getWorksheetRange.description: Reads a cell range from a worksheet in an Excel workbook as a JSON 2D array.

setWorksheetRange.label: Microsoft 365 Set Worksheet Range
setWorksheetRange.description: Writes a JSON 2D array of values into a cell range on a worksheet in an Excel workbook.

listTables.label: Microsoft 365 List Tables
listTables.description: Lists the tables in an Excel workbook stored in a user's OneDrive.

addTableRow.label: Microsoft 365 Add Table Row
addTableRow.description: Appends a row of values, given as a JSON array, to an Excel table.

listPlannerPlans.label: Microsoft 365 List Planner Plans
listPlannerPlans.description: Lists the Microsoft Planner plans owned by a group.

createPlannerTask.label: Microsoft 365 Create Planner Task
createPlannerTask.description: Creates a new task in a Microsoft Planner plan, optionally in a specific bucket.

listPlannerTasks.label: Microsoft 365 List Planner Tasks
listPlannerTasks.description: Lists the tasks in a Microsoft Planner plan.

listTodoLists.label: Microsoft 365 List To Do Lists
listTodoLists.description: Lists a user's Microsoft To Do task lists.

createTodoTask.label: Microsoft 365 Create To Do Task
createTodoTask.description: Creates a new task in a user's Microsoft To Do list.

listTodoTasks.label: Microsoft 365 List To Do Tasks
listTodoTasks.description: Lists the tasks in a user's Microsoft To Do list.

createContact.label: Microsoft 365 Create Contact
createContact.description: Creates a new contact in a user's Outlook contacts.

deleteContact.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Contact
deleteContact.description: Deletes a contact from a user's Outlook contacts by ID.

listApplications.label: Microsoft 365 List Applications
listApplications.description: Lists the app registrations in the Azure AD tenant, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

listDirectoryRoles.label: Microsoft 365 List Directory Roles
listDirectoryRoles.description: Lists the directory roles that are activated in the Azure AD tenant.

listUserLicenses.label: Microsoft 365 List User Licenses
listUserLicenses.description: Lists the license SKU IDs assigned to a user.

createSubscription.label: Microsoft 365 Create Subscription
createSubscription.description: Creates a Microsoft Graph change notification subscription (webhook) for a resource.

deleteSubscription.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Subscription
deleteSubscription.description: Deletes a Microsoft Graph change notification subscription by ID.

listTrendingDocuments.label: Microsoft 365 List Trending Documents
listTrendingDocuments.description: Lists documents trending around a user, based on Microsoft Graph insights.

request.label: Microsoft 365 Request
request.description: Sends a raw request to any Microsoft Graph API route not covered by the other Microsoft 365 nodes, e.g. "GET /me/drive".

authorize.label: Google Authorize
authorize.description: One-time setup step: exchanges the credential's staging Authorization Code for a long-lived Refresh Token to paste back into the Google OAuth2 credential.

driveListFiles.label: Google Drive List Files
driveListFiles.description: Lists files and folders, optionally filtered with a Drive query string (e.g. "'FOLDER_ID' in parents").

driveGetFile.label: Google Drive Get File
driveGetFile.description: Fetches a single file or folder's metadata by ID.

driveUploadFile.label: Google Drive Upload File
driveUploadFile.description: Creates a new file with the given content in the specified parent folder (or My Drive root if blank).

driveUpdateFileContent.label: Google Drive Update File Content
driveUpdateFileContent.description: Replaces an existing file's content by ID.

driveDownloadFile.label: Google Drive Download File
driveDownloadFile.description: Downloads a file's raw content by ID.

driveCreateFolder.label: Google Drive Create Folder
driveCreateFolder.description: Creates a new folder in the specified parent folder (or My Drive root if blank).

driveCopyFile.label: Google Drive Copy File
driveCopyFile.description: Copies a file to a new name and/or destination folder.

driveMoveFile.label: Google Drive Move File
driveMoveFile.description: Moves a file to a different folder by replacing all of its current parents with the destination folder.

driveRenameFile.label: Google Drive Rename File
driveRenameFile.description: Renames a file or folder in place.

driveDeleteFile.label: Google Drive Delete File
driveDeleteFile.description: Permanently deletes a file or folder by ID (bypasses Trash).

driveShareFile.label: Google Drive Share File
driveShareFile.description: Grants a role (Reader/Commenter/Writer/Owner) on a file to a user, group, domain, or anyone.

driveListPermissions.label: Google Drive List Permissions
driveListPermissions.description: Lists everyone a file is currently shared with.

driveDeletePermission.label: Google Drive Delete Permission
driveDeletePermission.description: Revokes a single sharing permission from a file by its permission ID.

sheetsGetValues.label: Google Sheets Get Values
sheetsGetValues.description: Reads a range of cell values (e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10") as a 2D JSON array.

sheetsUpdateValues.label: Google Sheets Update Values
sheetsUpdateValues.description: Overwrites a range of cells with a 2D JSON array of values.

sheetsAppendValues.label: Google Sheets Append Values
sheetsAppendValues.description: Appends a 2D JSON array of values as new rows after the last row with data in the given range.

sheetsClearValues.label: Google Sheets Clear Values
sheetsClearValues.description: Clears the values (not formatting) of a range of cells.

sheetsCreateSpreadsheet.label: Google Sheets Create Spreadsheet
sheetsCreateSpreadsheet.description: Creates a new blank spreadsheet with the given title.

sheetsAddSheet.label: Google Sheets Add Sheet
sheetsAddSheet.description: Adds a new sheet (tab) to an existing spreadsheet.

sheetsDeleteSheet.label: Google Sheets Delete Sheet
sheetsDeleteSheet.description: Deletes a sheet (tab) from a spreadsheet by its numeric sheet ID.

sheetsGetMetadata.label: Google Sheets Get Metadata
sheetsGetMetadata.description: Fetches a spreadsheet's title and the list of its sheet (tab) titles.

docsCreateDocument.label: Google Docs Create Document
docsCreateDocument.description: Creates a new blank document with the given title.

docsGetText.label: Google Docs Get Text
docsGetText.description: Fetches a document's body as plain text.

docsAppendText.label: Google Docs Append Text
docsAppendText.description: Appends text to the end of a document's body.

docsInsertText.label: Google Docs Insert Text
docsInsertText.description: Inserts text at a specific character index in a document's body.

docsReplaceAllText.label: Google Docs Replace All Text
docsReplaceAllText.description: Replaces every occurrence of a substring throughout a document's body.

gmailListMessages.label: Gmail List Messages
gmailListMessages.description: Lists messages in the mailbox, optionally filtered with a Gmail search query (e.g. "is:unread from:someone@example.com").

gmailGetMessage.label: Gmail Get Message
gmailGetMessage.description: Fetches a single message's headers and plain-text body by ID.

gmailSendMessage.label: Gmail Send Message
gmailSendMessage.description: Sends a plain-text email from the mailbox.

gmailTrashMessage.label: Gmail Trash Message
gmailTrashMessage.description: Moves a message to Trash by ID.

gmailListLabels.label: Gmail List Labels
gmailListLabels.description: Lists every label (system and user-created) in the mailbox.

gmailModifyMessageLabels.label: Gmail Modify Message Labels
gmailModifyMessageLabels.description: Adds and/or removes labels on a message by ID.

calendarListEvents.label: Google Calendar List Events
calendarListEvents.description: Lists events on a calendar within an optional time range, ordered by start time.

calendarGetEvent.label: Google Calendar Get Event
calendarGetEvent.description: Fetches a single event by ID.

calendarCreateEvent.label: Google Calendar Create Event
calendarCreateEvent.description: Creates a new event with a start/end date-time (RFC3339).

calendarUpdateEvent.label: Google Calendar Update Event
calendarUpdateEvent.description: Updates an existing event's summary, start/end, and/or description by ID.

calendarQuickAddEvent.label: Google Calendar Quick Add Event
calendarQuickAddEvent.description: Creates an event by parsing a single free-text string server-side (e.g. "Dinner with Sam Fri 8pm").

calendarListCalendars.label: Google Calendar List Calendars
calendarListCalendars.description: Lists every calendar on the account's calendar list.

adminListUsers.label: Google Admin List Users
adminListUsers.description: Lists Workspace users in the domain, optionally filtered with a query.

adminGetUser.label: Google Admin Get User
adminGetUser.description: Fetches a single Workspace user's profile by email or ID.

adminUpdateUser.label: Google Admin Update User
adminUpdateUser.description: Updates a Workspace user's properties by email or ID using a raw JSON object of the fields to change.

adminDeleteUser.label: Google Admin Delete User
adminDeleteUser.description: Deletes a Workspace user by email or ID.

adminListGroups.label: Google Admin List Groups
adminListGroups.description: Lists Workspace groups in the domain.

adminGetGroup.label: Google Admin Get Group
adminGetGroup.description: Fetches a single Workspace group by email or ID.

adminDeleteGroup.label: Google Admin Delete Group
adminDeleteGroup.description: Deletes a Workspace group by email or ID.

adminAddGroupMember.label: Google Admin Add Group Member
adminAddGroupMember.description: Adds a user to a group by email, with an optional role (MEMBER/MANAGER/OWNER).

adminRemoveGroupMember.label: Google Admin Remove Group Member
adminRemoveGroupMember.description: Removes a member from a group.

not.label: Not
not.description: Inverts a boolean value — true becomes false and false becomes true.

code.label: Code
code.description: Runs a user-authored TypeScript script node.

pgpEncrypt.label: PGP Encrypt
pgpEncrypt.description: Encrypts text for a recipient using their armored OpenPGP public key.

pgpDecrypt.label: PGP Decrypt
pgpDecrypt.description: Decrypts an armored OpenPGP message using the recipient's armored private key.

pkcs7Encrypt.label: PKCS7 Encrypt
pkcs7Encrypt.description: Encrypts text into a PKCS#7/CMS EnvelopedData structure (PEM) for a recipient's certificate.

pkcs7Decrypt.label: PKCS7 Decrypt
pkcs7Decrypt.description: Decrypts a PKCS#7/CMS EnvelopedData structure (PEM) using the recipient's private key.

toJson.label: CSV to JSON
toJson.description: Parses a CSV string into a JSON object, wrapping the rows under configurable root/row tags.

toCsv.label: JSON to CSV
toCsv.description: Converts a JSON object's tabular rows into a delimited CSV string.

toXml.label: CSV to XML
toXml.description: Parses a CSV string and converts it into an XML string with configurable root/row tags.

now.label: Now
now.description: Returns the current date and time as a Date.

fromString.label: To Date (String)
fromString.description: Parses a text string into a Date.

fromNumber.label: To Date (Number)
fromNumber.description: Converts a number of milliseconds since epoch into a Date.

subtract.label: Subtract ( - )
subtract.description: Returns the difference between two dates in milliseconds.

equal.label: Equal ( == )
equal.description: True if two dates represent the same moment in time.

unequal.label: Unequal ( != )
unequal.description: True if two dates do not represent the same moment in time.

greaterThan.label: Greater than ( > )
greaterThan.description: True if date A is later than date B.

greaterEqual.label: Greater equal ( >= )
greaterEqual.description: True if date A is later than or the same as date B.

lessThan.label: Less than ( < )
lessThan.description: True if date A is earlier than date B.

lessEqual.label: Less equal ( <= )
lessEqual.description: True if date A is earlier than or the same as date B.

print.label: Print
print.description: Logs a text message to the console for debugging.

printFormatted.label: Print (Formatted)
printFormatted.description: Logs a message pretty-printed according to a chosen format.

start.label: On Start
start.description: Fires once when the graph starts running.

interval.label: On Interval
interval.description: Fires repeatedly on a configurable interval, in milliseconds.

simulate.label: On Simulate
simulate.description: Fires when the editor's own Run button is pressed.

deploy.label: On Deploy
deploy.description: Fires once, right after the graph is deployed.

request.label: On HTTP Request
request.description: Fires when the deployed script's HTTP endpoint is called, outputting its user-declared request fields.

execute.label: On Execute
execute.description: Fires when another Flow calls this one via Execute Flow, outputting its user-declared fields.

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: Pauses the exec chain for a given duration in milliseconds.

branch.label: Branch
branch.description: Routes execution to True or False based on a condition.

isValid.label: Is Valid
isValid.description: Routes execution to Is Valid or Is Not Valid based on whether the object is null/undefined.

forLoop.label: For Loop
forLoop.description: Runs its Loop Body once for each index from Start to End.

sequence.label: Sequence
sequence.description: Runs each Then branch to completion, one after another.

parallel.label: Parallel
parallel.description: Runs all branches at once and continues once every branch finishes.

return.label: Return Flow Values
return.description: Ends this Flow's run, declaring the values an Execute Flow node calling it can read back.

executeFlow.label: Execute Flow
executeFlow.description: Runs another Flow's deployed script and waits for it to finish, reading back whatever it declared via Return Flow Values.

entry.label: Entry
entry.description: Starts a function's body and outputs its call's input arguments.

return.label: Return
return.description: Ends a function's body, sending its output values back to the caller.

call.label: Call Function
call.description: Invokes a user-defined function with the given arguments.

request.label: HTTP Request
request.description: Sends an HTTP request with a chosen method, headers, optional auth, and body, returning the response status, body, and headers.

send.label: Send Webhook
send.description: POSTs a JSON payload to an external URL, with optional HMAC-SHA256 request signing and a bounded retry loop with linear backoff for transient failures.

make.label: Make Map
make.description: Builds a new map from the given key-value pairs.

length.label: Map Length
length.description: Returns how many key-value pairs are in the map.

set.label: Map Add
set.description: Sets the value for a key, adding it or overwriting the existing one.

remove.label: Map Remove
remove.description: Removes the entry for a key, if one exists.

clear.label: Map Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty map, discarding all entries.

containsKey.label: Map Contains Key
containsKey.description: True if the map has an entry stored under this key.

find.label: Map Find
find.description: Returns the value stored under a key, and whether it was found.

keys.label: Map Keys
keys.description: Returns an array of every key currently in the map.

values.label: Map Values
values.description: Returns an array of every value currently in the map.

isEmpty.label: Map Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the map has no entries.

forEach.label: Map For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each key-value pair in the map.

clamp.label: Clamp
clamp.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

max.label: Max
max.description: Returns the larger of two numbers.

min.label: Min
min.description: Returns the smaller of two numbers.

greaterThan.label: Greater than ( > )
greaterThan.description: True if A is greater than B.

greaterEqual.label: Greater equal ( >= )
greaterEqual.description: True if A is greater than or equal to B.

lessThan.label: Less than ( < )
lessThan.description: True if A is less than B.

lessEqual.label: Less equal ( <= )
lessEqual.description: True if A is less than or equal to B.

equal.label: Equal ( == )
equal.description: True if A and B are numerically equal.

unequal.label: Unequal ( != )
unequal.description: True if A and B are not numerically equal.

v2Request.label: OData V2 Request
v2Request.description: Fetches every page of an OData v2 GET request — client-driven $top/$skip (1000 rows per page by default) or server-driven cursor/snapshot next-link paging — and returns the combined rows.

data.label: Reroute
data.description: Bends a wire's path on the canvas with no effect on behavior.

exec.label: Reroute
exec.description: Bends an exec wire's path on the canvas with no effect on behavior.

make.label: Make Set
make.description: Builds a new set from the given elements, dropping duplicates.

length.label: Set Length
length.description: Returns how many unique elements are in the set.

add.label: Set Add
add.description: Adds a value to the set, unless it's already present.

remove.label: Set Remove
remove.description: Removes a value from the set if it is present.

clear.label: Set Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty set, discarding all elements.

contains.label: Set Contains
contains.description: True if the set already contains this value.

isEmpty.label: Set Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the set has no elements.

toArray.label: Set To Array
toArray.description: Converts the set's elements into an ordinary array.

union.label: Set Union
union.description: Combines two sets, keeping every distinct element from both.

intersection.label: Set Intersection
intersection.description: Returns only the elements present in both sets.

difference.label: Set Difference
difference.description: Returns elements in the first set that aren't in the second.

forEach.label: Set For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each element in the set.

upload.label: SFTP Upload
upload.description: Uploads a file to an SFTP server, with reconnect handling and configurable existing-file behavior. Compiled output only — see this node's own tooltip note below.

call.label: SOAP Call
call.description: Calls an operation on a SOAP web service via its WSDL. Compiled output only — see this node's own tooltip note below.

describe.label: SOAP Describe
describe.description: Fetches a WSDL and lists the services, ports and operations it exposes. Compiled output only — see this node's own tooltip note below.

fromNumber.label: To String (Number)
fromNumber.description: Converts a number to its text representation.

fromBoolean.label: To String (Boolean)
fromBoolean.description: Converts a boolean to its text representation.

fromDate.label: To String (Date)
fromDate.description: Converts a date to an ISO 8601 text string.

fromJson.label: To String (JSON)
fromJson.description: Converts a value to its JSON text representation.

equalCaseSensitive.label: Equal ( == ) case-sensitive
equalCaseSensitive.description: True if two strings are exactly equal, case-sensitive.

equalCaseInsensitive.label: Equal ( == ) case-insensitive
equalCaseInsensitive.description: True if two strings are equal, ignoring letter case.

length.label: Length
length.description: Returns how many characters are in the string.

replace.label: Replace
replace.description: Replaces only the first occurrence of a substring with another string.

replaceAll.label: Replace All
replaceAll.description: Replaces every occurrence of a substring with another string.

substring.label: Substring
substring.description: Returns the characters between Start and End (order-independent, clamped to the string's bounds).

slice.label: Slice
slice.description: Returns the characters between Start and End, where a negative index counts from the string's end.

append.label: Append String
append.description: Concatenates all of its string inputs into one result.

get.label: Get Variable
get.description: Reads the bound variable's current value.

set.label: Set Variable
set.description: Writes a new value to the bound variable.

toJson.label: XML to JSON
toJson.description: Parses an XML string into a JSON object, failing safely with success:false on invalid XML.

fromJson.label: JSON to XML
fromJson.description: Builds an XML string from a JSON object.

toCsv.label: XML to CSV
toCsv.description: Parses an XML string's tabular rows and converts them into a delimited CSV string.
